examples.text: Eine Mehrheit der EU-Länder hat sich für ein Ende russischer Gaslieferungen bis Ende 2027 ausgesprochen. examples.translation: A majority of EU countries have declared themselves in favour of an end to Russian gas deliveries by the end of 2027. The energy ministers of the EU voted for a law that envisages a gradual phaseout. Slovakia and Hungary, who still receive large quantities of gas from Russia, were outvoted.
